summary: 40 proposals judged: 34 PASS, 6 FAIL (85%). The cuts held up well: 26 of 27 passed, and the readers checked the bodies honestly. The failures share one pattern: types and labels promoted further than the prose supports. A page that supplies one primitive gets called an instance (Photonic exemplifies). A one-sided 'structurally' gets called a mirror (Stoicism). A diffuse 'would later name' gets called spawned, and the dates rule that out (Founding Conversation). Two rewordings rest on a bridge the reader built rather than one either page states (Slime Mold adaptive-coupling, Playful play-is-how-learning-happens).
